title: Lean
description: This mod adds lean in minecraft
body:
Its just a simple mod, whats adds lean in minecraft

![This is brown bottle craft. This craft is similar to the regular bottle craft, but it uses brown glass and paper in the middle.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4228ee032e421a3521a0e1617ab7cb105a52afd.png)

![This is a sprite bottle craft. This craft is similar to the regular bottle craft, but it uses paper in the middle and lime dye on top of the paper.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c63ce805d5016707cb571a789592023a263773d.png)

![This is a malic acid craft. It uses a bottle of water and apple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/128d38306ebb4a4880a1f4702aee58eef2c61453.png)


For this craft you need a brown bottle with water (to get it you need right mouse click your brown bottle on a water)

![This is a cough syrup craft. It uses an opium poppy, sugar and brown bottle with water](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c67d8e509381c97c58e3562c172321e5132408b2.png)


For this craft you need a sprite bottle with water (to get it you need right mouse click your sprite bottle on a water)

![This is sprite craft. It uses malic acid, sugar and sprite bottle with water](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d7921dbaf8b2391676ae237635546520c860ff1.png)

![This is lean craft. It uses sprite and cough syrup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2507d08d59f91b2986896760aab11c9aecdde8b6.png)
